2609.18861.title: PersonaPath: Towards Knowledge-Centric Personalized Learning Path Planning
2609.18861.paper_summary: Adaptive learning systems commonly formulate learning path planning as Exercise-Centric (EC) recommendation, where the next step is inferred from item-level interaction logs. Evaluating goal-oriented guidance additionally requires explicit learner goals and curriculum-scale prerequisites: learners with similar exercise records may need different paths toward their targets. We therefore study Knowledge-Centric (KC) personalized learning path planning, where a planner must reason over learner profiles, mastery states, and prerequisite knowledge structures to decide which textbook, unit, and concept should be studied next. To support this setting, we introduce PersonaPath, a benchmark that pairs 2,000 fine-grained learner personas with a hierarchical knowledge graph of 347 textbooks, 1,751 units, and 4,092 concepts across 77 subjects. We evaluate representative LLMs on PersonaPath. Results show that even the strongest LLM reaches only a 29.5% final pass rate in Basic Education, and that the main bottleneck lies in adaptivity, where no model exceeds 44.7% in tailoring paths to individual learners.
2609.18861.paper_summary_zh: 自適應學習系統通常將學習路徑規劃表述為以練習為中心（Exercise-Centric, EC）的推薦，其中下一步是從項目級的互動日誌中推斷出來的。評估以目標為導向的指導還需要明確的學習者目標和課程級的先決條件：擁有相似練習記錄的學習者可能需要不同的路徑來達成他們的目標。因此，我們研究以知識為中心（Knowledge-Centric, KC）的個性化學習路徑規劃，規劃者必須根據學習者的檔案、掌握狀態和先決知識結構進行推理，以決定下一步應學習哪本教科書、單元和概念。為了支持這一設定，我們引入了PersonaPath，一個基準，將2,000個細緻的學習者角色與347本教科書、1,751個單元和4,092個概念的層次知識圖譜配對，涵蓋77個科目。我們在PersonaPath上評估了代表性的LLM。結果顯示，即使是最強的LLM在基礎教育中的最終通過率也僅為29.5%，而主要瓶頸在於適應性，沒有任何模型在為個別學習者量身定制路徑方面超過44.7%。
